dimensions.mission: Remove the recurring rewrite of a historical evidence file on every Catalog PR without losing any guard.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Historical evidence untouched and not rewritten; aggregate pins become snapshot-only, other pins and frozen registry unchanged.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One shared frozenset from existing harness_sync constants; no new registry or config.
dimensions.research_truth: No data, PIT or estimand path touched; stale aggregate shas in old acceptances are explicit snapshots recoverable from Git.
dimensions.owner_operability: Ordinary Catalog PRs stop failing preflight on an unsatisfiable pin; owner phrase flow unchanged.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Revert is an ordinary Git revert; harness_sync.check_drift still guards aggregates.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Reuses existing constants and scan; nothing built.
dimensions.security: No network, credentials, provider, wallet or settings change.
dimensions.red_team: Product-path pins still DENY (10 DENYs for task21_owner_pulse.py before and after); exempt set is path-exact.

recovery: Ordinary Git revert of the task commits restores the prior scan.
